title: Maande Nder Kaaƴe
intro: E nder leydi ɗo koɗe njuɓɓinaa e galleeji, nulaaɗo ari ina jogii maande kaawis ummoraade e Alla. Yimɓe ɓee ɗaɓɓiri hujjaaji, ɓe keɓi tagoore ummoraade e haayre tiiɗnde. Kono mawnikinaare maɓɓe addani ɓe salaade jeertinaango ngoo, siifde baasal maɓɓe.
clues: Mi neldaama to leñol hoɗɓe e cuuɗi cewɗi e dow koye.
Ɓe ndartini mi ngam addude maande, ko ɗuum waɗi mi yaltini gelooɗi e haayre.
Mi yamiriino ɓe yoo gelooɗi ɗii yara haa mbelna, taa bonna ɗum.
Ɓe njaɓaani, ɓe mberli gelooɗi ɗii, ɓe njaɓaani jeertinaango am.
Mi anndinii wonde jukkungo maa artu caggal balɗe tati.
Subaka law, ɓuuɓol mawngol yani e maɓɓe, kono miin e almuɓɓe am min ndañii.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Ɗaɓɓaande taƴre yaajnde gila e asamaan

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
